page.title: Cappuccino
page.meta_description: Cappuccino sits beside espresso as the milk drink whose foam and ratio baristas argue about, later a canvas for latte art. Related pages: Espresso, Latte art.
page.content:
Espresso with textured milk, the everyday milk drink of the bar.

How Cappuccino connects

  • Item: Espresso — Cappuccino is built on a shot of espresso and textured milk.
  • Item: Latte art — Latte art is poured onto milk drinks such as cappuccino.

What is Cappuccino?

Cappuccino sits beside espresso as the milk drink whose foam and ratio baristas argue about, later a canvas for latte art.

Key threads lead to Espresso and Latte art.
